name: MonarchAiUserMessageEdit
title: AiUserMessageEdit
summary: An inline editor for a prompt the person already sent: a multi-line text field, a note that resending starts a new branch, and Cancel and Send buttons.
whenToUse: In a conversation, in place of a sent message while the person edits it to ask again.
whenNotToUse: For writing a new prompt use the prompt input. For a single-line labelled field use MonarchTextField.
api: MonarchAiUserMessageEdit.init(_ original: String, maxLines: Int = 10, label: String? = nil, branchHint: String? = nil, sendLabel: String? = nil, cancelLabel: String? = nil, focusesOnAppear: Bool = true, onCancel: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void, onSubmit: @escaping @MainActor (String) -> Void)

options.name: original
options.description: The prompt as it was sent. The field starts with it.

options.name: maxLines
options.description: The number of lines the field grows to before it scrolls. At least 2.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken label "Edit message".

options.name: branchHint
options.description: Replaces the built-in note that resending keeps the original.

options.name: focusesOnAppear
options.description: Whether the field takes focus when it appears.

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Runs when Cancel is activated. Leave edit mode here.

options.name: onSubmit
options.description: Runs with the trimmed text when Send is activated.

states.name: unchanged or empty
states.description: Send is disabled: the trimmed text is empty or equal to the trimmed original.

states.name: changed
states.description: Send is the primary button and calls onSubmit with the trimmed text.

states.name: focused
states.description: The theme's focus ring is drawn around the field.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field uses the subtle fill and disabled text, and both buttons are disabled, with the standard disabled(_:) modifier.

appearance: The field is a surface with the input border role, like MonarchTextField. The note uses the muted text role with an info symbol. Send is the primary button and Cancel the ghost button. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: On the web Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. On iOS Return adds a line, as in every multi-line field, so Send is a button; with a hardware keyboard Command-Return sends and Escape cancels. The web's hidden keyboard hint is therefore not shown. The field starts two lines high (the web's minimum height is 64px). The text is held by the component; it is reset only when the view is recreated.
accessibility: The field is labelled "Edit message" (or label) and the branch note is its hint.
The visible note and its icon are hidden from VoiceOver, so the note is not read twice.
Send is disabled, and exposed as dimmed, until the text can be resent.
The field is at least 44 points high and both buttons keep a 44-point touch target.
Text scales with Dynamic Type; the buttons stack when they do not fit on one line.
Send has the Command-Return keyboard shortcut and Cancel the system cancel shortcut (Escape).
edgeCases: Leading and trailing white space and line breaks are trimmed before comparing and before onSubmit.
A maxLines below 2 is treated as 2.
Text longer than maxLines scrolls inside the field.
focusesOnAppear raises the keyboard as soon as the editor is shown.

examples.title: Edit and resend
examples.template:
MonarchAiUserMessageEdit(
    message,
    focusesOnAppear: false,
    onCancel: {},
    onSubmit: { text in message = text }
)
.frame(maxWidth: 576)
